overview_description.description: Fitze is a UAE-based fitness and wellness platform that combines activity tracking with reward-based engagement. The company operates a mobile application that converts users’ daily steps into digital coins redeemable for discounts, offers, and promotional rewards from partner brands. The platform also organizes fitness challenges, jackpot campaigns, and corporate wellness programs aimed at encouraging healthier lifestyles and employee engagement

product.name: Fitze Fitness Rewards App
product.description: A mobile app that tracks users' steps and rewards them with coins redeemable for prizes and discounts.

product.name: Fitze Pro Subscription
product.description: A premium subscription offering enhanced rewards, unlimited challenges, and access to exclusive jackpots within the Fitze app.

product.name: Fitze Steps Challenges
product.description: Preset walking step goals that users can join to compete for rewards and prizes.

product.name: Fitze Jackpots
product.description: Timed events where users who meet step targets enter draws to win prizes such as cash, cars, and trips.

product.name: Corporate Virtual Steps Challenges
product.description: Customizable virtual walking challenges for companies to engage employees remotely and promote wellness.
